about: The Workbench icon of the AmigaCLISP drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py icons/icons.json --out icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/amigaclisp.png, a lambda on a tile, 128 x 128) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files. AmigaCLISP.info is the drawer's own icon (package/build-amiga.sh puts it beside the drawer); ReadMe.info and CLISP.info (the CLISP script, run by IconX) go in it.
